summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in csec-form-validatorr@0.0.0-stage
details: Package csec-form-validatorr version 0.0.0-stage ships a minimal set of files with no observed install-time lifecycle execution, no network exfiltration, no credential or filesystem reads outside the package, and no code that would harm an installer on npm install or require. The version suffix and small file count are consistent with a placeholder or staging release rather than a functional library. The package name resembles a form-validation utility but no concrete malicious behavior is present in the shipped contents.
